name: Clarissa Waverley
source:
Clarissa Waverley is the second child of the Waverley children. She is first seen in Chapter 2.

Clarissa is a cheerful and optimistic teenager. Just like Simon, she greets Your Character to the manor warmly. In Chapter 3, it's revealed that she enjoys poetry and has a crush on a boy in town named Edmund who she wants to send a poem to, but always chickens out. If Your Character says that she prefers girls, Clarissa is not scandalized by it and still asks for help with her poem. 

[spoiler]Clarissa is the only younger sibling that is cautious about how long they've been in the manor. She comments in Chapter 3 that she hasn't seen the mailman in forever.[/spoiler]

[Edited from the [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Clarissa_Waverley]Wiki[/url]]
